options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: delete
options.description: A list of settings you want to delete.

options.name: dhcp_dns_server
options.description: IP address for the DNS server.

options.name: dhcp_range
options.description: Range of IP addresses for DHCP.

options.name: dhcp_range_update_mode
options.description: Only applicable for O(state=present) and it will honor and only make changes when O(update=true) If set to append and new dhcp_range passed it will just append to existing ranges. And If no dhcp_range passed and there are existing ranges it will just ignore existing ranges and only update other params if needed If set to overwrite and new dhcp_range passed it will overwrite existing ranges. If no dhcp_range passed and there are existing ranges it will delete all dhcp_ranges

options.name: dnszoneprefix
options.description: Prefix for the DNS zone.

options.name: gateway
options.description: Subnet Gateway. Will be assign on vnet for layer3 zones.

options.name: lock_token
options.description: the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration.

options.name: snat
options.description: Enable Source NAT for the subnet.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the subnet configuration.

options.name: subnet
options.description: Subnet CIDR.

options.name: update
options.description: If O(state=present) then it will update the subnet if needed.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: vnet
options.description: The virtual network to which the subnet belongs.

options.name: zone
options.description: Vnet Zone.
